title: DX_DFIR detection exchange — STIX 2.1 property extension
description: The properties the DX_DFIR (Byakugan) detection exchange adds to the STIX 2.1 objects it produces, under extensions["extension-definition--0a37fc5b-cf2b-5ae9-84aa-933110a32190"] (extension_type property-extension, STIX 2.1 §7.3). On an indicator: the detection rule's id, severity and status. On a sighting: the case, run, CAR-object and Elastic alert pointers, the evidence source, and — for an indicator-match sighting — the feed, the matched field / value and the matched indicator's descriptors. On a relationship: whether a rule author declared it or it was derived from evidence. Version 1.0.0.

detection_id.description: The detection rule id (detect/rules/<id>.yml; on an indicator also its dxdfir external reference).

severity.description: The rule's severity (low / medium / high / critical) on an indicator; the alert's severity on a sighting.

status.description: The rules-as-code status of the rule behind an indicator.

case_id.description: The case the observation belongs to — what scopes the sighting's id.

run_id.description: The detection run that produced the hit.

car_guid.description: The CAR object guid (event.id) the sighted evidence line came from — the pointer back to the CAR row.

source.description: Where the evidence was read: the Elasticsearch index / data stream or the lane's source name.

feed.description: Indicator-match sighting: the threat feed the matched indicator came from (threat.feed.name).

alert_ids.description: Indicator-match sighting: the Elastic alert ids (kibana.alert.uuid) collapsed into this sighting.

field.description: The evidence field that matched (source.ip, file.hash.sha256 ...).

index.description: The cti-* index the indicator was matched in.

id.description: The matched indicator's STIX id (also the sighting_of_ref).

indicator.description: Indicator-match sighting: the matched indicator as the cti-* copy described it.

type.description: threat.indicator.type — the STIX SCO type of the atomic.

relationship_class.description: On a relationship: declared by a rule author (the rule's ATT&CK mapping) or derived from evidence / inference.
